content: Free speech is restored in India, and you won't find me being aggressive here on LinkedIn, as the public is now finally awakened. I have used plenty of BJP IT Cell (I mean Israel's MOSSAD) tactics here to counter them via algorithm hijacking by "rampant commenting" and "uniting people" strategically.
comment: Online influence tactics can amplify voices, but long-term credibility still depends on transparency, evidence, and constructive dialogue. Algorithms may open doors; trust determines who stays in the room.
